horizon: Events from now to about 18 months ahead

events.name: ESMO Congress 2026
events.summary: Europe's largest oncology congress, where major cancer trial results, new therapies and treatment guidelines are presented to clinicians, researchers and industry.

pharma.why: Late-breaking oncology trial data that moves drug valuations and pipelines.

healthcare.why: Sets clinical practice for cancer care across Europe.

diagnostics.why: Biomarker and companion-diagnostic studies feature heavily.

investment.why: Analysts and investors track readouts closely.

ai.why: Growing sessions on AI in oncology imaging and pathology.

events.name: Unlock New Insights in Microbiology and Infectious Disease Research
events.summary: Online event on new tools and findings in microbiology and infectious disease research.

biosecurity.why: Infectious disease research methods relevant to pathogen surveillance and preparedness.

diagnostics.why: Covers lab methods used to detect and characterise microbes.

healthcare.why: Infectious disease research with clinical relevance.

events.name: Synthetic Biology UK 2026
events.summary: The UK's main academic synthetic biology meeting, covering engineered organisms, genetic circuits, biofoundries and applications in health, industry and the environment.

industrial.why: Engineered microbes and pathways for making chemicals and materials.

fermentation.why: Strain engineering that underpins precision fermentation.

biosecurity.why: Responsible innovation and biosafety of engineered organisms are recurring topics.

pharma.why: Some sessions on synthetic biology for therapeutics.

events.name: Lab Innovations 2026
events.summary: UK trade show for laboratory equipment, automation and lab services, with free talks on lab efficiency, digital labs and sustainability.

diagnostics.why: Lab instruments and automation used in clinical and research labs.

ai.why: Lab digitalisation, data and automation talks.

bioprocessing.why: Suppliers of lab-scale bioprocess and analytical kit.

pharma.why: R&D lab suppliers serving drug discovery.

events.name: BIO-Europe 2026
events.summary: Europe's largest biotech partnering event: thousands of pre-booked one-to-one meetings between biotechs, pharma and investors, plus panels on deals and financing. Digital partnering follows on 17–18 November.

investment.why: The key European venue for licensing deals and investor meetings.

pharma.why: Big pharma business development teams attend in force.

healthcare.why: Medtech and digital health have their own tracks.

diagnostics.why: Diagnostics companies seek partners and funding.

ai.why: AI drug discovery companies pitch and partner here.

events.name: Clinical Diagnostics & Research Virtual Event Series 2026
events.summary: Online talks on clinical laboratory diagnostics, molecular testing and translational research.

diagnostics.why: Dedicated to clinical diagnostics and lab testing.

healthcare.why: Lab medicine that informs patient care.

events.name: MEDICA 2026
events.summary: The world's largest medical trade fair, covering medical devices, diagnostics, lab equipment, digital health and hospital technology. Runs alongside COMPAMED for device components.

meddevices.why: The biggest global showcase for medical device makers and suppliers.

defence.why: Some military and emergency medicine suppliers exhibit.

events.name: bioProcessUK 2026
events.summary: The UK's main bioprocessing conference, bringing together industry and academia on manufacturing biologics, cell and gene therapies and other bio-based products.

bioprocessing.why: The UK's flagship meeting on biomanufacturing and process development.

pharma.why: Manufacturing of antibodies, vaccines and advanced therapies.

industrial.why: Scale-up lessons that apply to industrial biotech.

fermentation.why: Upstream cell culture and microbial fermentation sessions.

events.name: SynbiTECH 2026
events.summary: Industry-focused synthetic biology conference at the IET in London, connecting start-ups, investors, corporates and policy makers in engineering biology.

industrial.why: Commercial engineering biology for chemicals, materials and manufacturing.

biosecurity.why: UK engineering biology policy and responsible innovation.

events.name: ASH Annual Meeting 2026
events.summary: The largest blood disorders and blood cancer meeting, where key data on leukaemia, lymphoma, myeloma, gene therapies for blood diseases and CAR-T are presented.

pharma.why: Major readouts for blood cancer drugs and cell and gene therapies.

investment.why: Data here moves biotech share prices.

diagnostics.why: Minimal residual disease and blood diagnostics.

events.name: J.P. Morgan Healthcare Conference 2027
events.summary: The healthcare industry's biggest investor week. Company presentations are by invitation, but the whole sector gathers in San Francisco for side events, deals and meetings.

investment.why: The year's biggest week for biotech financing and deal announcements.

pharma.why: Big pharma sets out strategy and M&A appetite.

ai.why: AI and techbio side events are now common.

events.name: Biotech Showcase 2027
events.summary: Investor and partnering conference held during JPM week, where emerging biotechs present to investors and hold one-to-one meetings.

investment.why: Built for start-ups meeting investors during JPM week.

events.name: World Health Expo (WHX) Dubai 2027
events.summary: Formerly Arab Health: one of the largest healthcare trade shows, covering medical devices, hospital equipment, digital health and healthcare investment in the Middle East.

meddevices.why: Huge medical device exhibition and gateway to Gulf markets.

healthcare.why: Hospital groups and health ministries attend.

diagnostics.why: Linked with the WHX Labs show the same week.

events.name: WHX Labs Dubai 2027
events.summary: Formerly Medlab Middle East: laboratory and diagnostics exhibition with conference tracks on lab medicine, held at Dubai World Trade Centre.

diagnostics.why: The region's main laboratory and diagnostics show.

events.name: Food Sciences & Technology Conference 2027: Precision Fermentation for Future Foods
events.summary: Three-day scientific conference on precision fermentation for food: from bioreactor to ingredient, ingredient to food product, and consumer acceptance.

bioprocessing.why: Bioreactor and downstream processing for food ingredients.

events.name: Festival of Genomics & Biodata 2027
events.summary: Large genomics and biodata event at ExCeL London, covering sequencing, genomic medicine, multi-omics and data science, with a big exhibition.

healthcare.why: Genomic medicine in the NHS and beyond.

events.name: SLAS2027 International Conference & Exhibition
events.organiser: Society for Laboratory Automation and Screening
events.summary: Leading conference on lab automation, high-throughput screening, robotics and data science in life sciences, with a large exhibition.

ai.why: Lab data, machine learning and automation.

diagnostics.why: Automation for clinical and research labs.

events.name: AI in Life Sciences Virtual Event Series 2027
events.summary: Online event series on applying AI and machine learning in research, drug discovery and diagnostics.

ai.why: Dedicated to AI in life sciences.

events.name: Drug Discovery & Development Virtual Event Series 2027
events.summary: Online event series covering target discovery, screening, preclinical models and development.

pharma.why: Focused on drug discovery and development.

events.name: Chemical and Biological Defense Gordon Research Conference 2027
events.summary: Small, invitation-style scientific conference on defending against chemical and biological threats: detection, medical countermeasures, decontamination and protection.

defence.why: Core chem-bio defence science, with military and government researchers.

diagnostics.why: Rapid detection and sensing of agents.

events.name: World Vaccine Congress Washington 2027
events.summary: One of the largest vaccine industry meetings, covering vaccine R&D, manufacturing, policy and pandemic preparedness. Co-located with the World BioSecurity Congress.

events.name: World BioSecurity Congress & Expo USA 2027
events.summary: New congress and exhibition on biosurveillance, threat awareness, biosafety, preparedness and medical countermeasures, co-located with the World Vaccine Congress.

biosecurity.why: Entirely focused on biosecurity and biothreats.

events.name: World Agri-Tech Innovation Summit 2027
events.summary: Global agtech investment and innovation summit connecting growers, agribusiness, start-ups and investors on biologicals, crop genetics and farm technology.

agrifood.why: The main US agtech business summit.

investment.why: Agtech investors and corporate venture arms.

ai.why: Data and AI on the farm.

events.name: Future Food-Tech San Francisco 2027
events.summary: Business summit for food innovation: alternative proteins, precision fermentation, ingredients and food brands meeting investors and corporates.

agrifood.why: Food innovation and alternative protein business.

fermentation.why: Precision and biomass fermentation companies are central.

events.name: Security & Policing 2027
events.summary: The UK government's official security exhibition, including CBRN detection and response. Not open to the public: visitors must be approved against Home Office criteria.

defence.why: Government and security buyers, including CBRN capability.

biosecurity.why: CBRN detection, protection and response technology.

events.name: Laboratory Automation Virtual Event Series 2027
events.summary: Online talks on lab robotics, automation workflows and lab data.

events.name: Bioprocessing Virtual Event Series 2027
events.summary: Online event series on upstream and downstream bioprocessing, analytics and manufacturing.

events.name: AACR Annual Meeting 2027
events.summary: The largest cancer research meeting, spanning basic science, early drug discovery, clinical trials and cancer diagnostics.

pharma.why: Early clinical and preclinical oncology data.

ai.why: AI in cancer research and pathology.

events.name: BIO-Europe Spring 2027
events.summary: Spring edition of Europe's leading biotech partnering conference, with pre-booked one-to-one meetings between biotechs, pharma and investors.

investment.why: Major spring deal-making and fundraising venue.

ai.why: AI and techbio companies take part.

events.name: ESCMID Global 2027
events.organiser: European Society of Clinical Microbiology and Infectious Diseases
events.summary: The world's largest infectious disease and clinical microbiology congress, covering antimicrobial resistance, outbreaks, vaccines and diagnostics.

biosecurity.why: Outbreaks, emerging pathogens and antimicrobial resistance.

events.name: BioProcess International Europe 2027
events.summary: Europe's major bioprocessing conference and exhibition, covering biologics and advanced therapy manufacturing, process development and supply chain.

pharma.why: Biologics and cell and gene therapy manufacturing.

fermentation.why: Upstream cell culture and microbial systems.

events.name: Immuno-Oncology Virtual Event Series 2027
events.summary: Online talks on cancer immunotherapy research, from checkpoint biology to cell therapies.

events.name: SynBioBeta 2027
events.summary: The leading synthetic biology business conference, bringing together founders, investors and corporates working on engineered biology for health, food, materials and climate.

investment.why: Synbio founders and investors meet here.

fermentation.why: Precision fermentation companies are well represented.

ai.why: AI for protein and strain design.

events.name: ASGCT 2027 Annual Meeting
events.organiser: American Society of Gene & Cell Therapy
events.summary: The main meeting for gene and cell therapy science and industry, including gene editing, viral vectors, CAR-T and manufacturing.

pharma.why: Gene and cell therapy pipelines and data.

events.name: BIO€quity Europe 2027
events.summary: Investor conference where European private and public biotechs present to venture and public market investors.

events.name: Precision Medicine: Genomics, Proteomics & Molecular Diagnostics Virtual Event 2027
events.summary: Online event series on genomics, proteomics and molecular diagnostics in precision medicine.

events.name: Bio-IT World Conference & Expo 2027
events.summary: The leading conference on data, IT and AI in life sciences: research informatics, cloud, lab data and AI for drug discovery.

ai.why: AI and data science in biotech and pharma.

events.name: DeviceTalks Boston 2027
events.summary: Medical device industry conference on product development, engineering, regulation and commercialisation.

meddevices.why: Built for medtech engineers and leaders.

events.name: BIO International Convention 2027
events.summary: The world's largest biotech gathering, with partnering meetings, policy sessions and an exhibition spanning therapeutics, agriculture, industrial biotech and biodefence.

investment.why: Huge partnering system and investor presence.

biosecurity.why: Biodefence and pandemic preparedness policy sessions.

events.name: ACHEMA 2027
events.summary: The world's leading process industry trade fair, with major halls for pharma and biotech process equipment, lab technology and industrial biotechnology.

bioprocessing.why: Bioreactors, purification and process equipment at scale.

events.name: ADLM 2027 Annual Meeting & Clinical Lab Expo
events.summary: The largest clinical laboratory and diagnostics meeting, with a big expo of diagnostic instruments and tests.

diagnostics.why: The main global diagnostics and lab medicine event.

events.name: Microbiology Virtual Event Series 2027
events.summary: Online event series on microbiology research, infectious disease and microbial methods.

events.name: DSEI 2027
events.summary: One of the world's largest defence and security exhibitions, including CBRN defence, military medicine and defence innovation zones. Attendance is restricted to trade visitors.

events.name: The MedTech Conference 2027
events.summary: AdvaMed's annual medtech industry conference on policy, regulation, reimbursement, investment and partnering.

meddevices.why: The main US medtech industry meeting.

events.name: Cell & Gene Therapy Virtual Event Series 2027
events.summary: Online event series on cell and gene therapy research, development and manufacturing.

events.name: ABSA Biosafety & Biosecurity Conference 2027
events.summary: Annual conference of ABSA International, the biosafety professionals' association, covering lab biosafety, biosecurity, high-containment labs and risk management.

biosecurity.why: The main professional biosafety and biosecurity meeting.

events.name: HLTH USA 2027
events.summary: Large health innovation conference bringing together providers, payers, pharma, tech companies, start-ups and investors.

healthcare.why: Health system innovation and digital health.

ai.why: AI in healthcare is a major theme.

events.name: World BioSecurity Congress & Expo Europe 2027
events.summary: European edition of the World BioSecurity Congress, on biosurveillance, preparedness and medical countermeasures, co-located with World Vaccine Congress Europe.

defence.why: Biodefence and countermeasure procurement in Europe.

events.name: CRISPR Virtual Event Series 2027
events.summary: Online event series on CRISPR and gene editing tools and applications.

agrifood.why: Gene editing in crops and animals.

biosecurity.why: Dual-use and governance of gene editing.

events.name: CPHI Frankfurt 2027
events.summary: The largest pharmaceutical supply chain exhibition, covering ingredients, contract development and manufacturing (CDMOs), biologics and packaging.

pharma.why: Pharma ingredient and manufacturing supply chain.

events.summary: Online talks on clinical laboratory diagnostics, molecular testing and translational research.
